name: google-business-profile-search-keywords
description: Shows what people typed into Google Search and Maps before your Google Business Profile listing appeared, from live Google Business Profile data in your Coupler.io workspace — searches for your name against searches for what you do, the terms bringing the most people, terms new this month and terms that disappeared, with the terms Google withholds counted honestly instead of as zero. Use for "what do people search to find us on Google Maps", "which keywords show our Google listing", "are people finding us by name or by category", "GBP search terms", "Google My Business search queries", "are we showing up for [service] near me" — even when the user never says "keywords". This is the how-they-found-you view. For views, calls and directions use google-business-profile-performance-report; for what people search before visiting the website use branded-vs-non-branded-search-traffic. Google Business Profile only.
